title: Smooth purity map
statement:
Under the finite-coefficient purity conventions of this chapter [def-pur-conventions], fix the global finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $n\geq1$, and put $\Lambda=A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type $k$-morphism [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism] that is smooth of pure relative dimension $d\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Work on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y_{\Proet},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Put $M=Lf^*_{\Lambda}K$ and $\omega_f=Rf^!_{\Lambda}\Lambda_Y$ [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], and write $M(d)=M\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}\Lambda_X(d)$ for the coefficient twist [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Let

$$
\Pi_f:\omega_f\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\Lambda_X(d)[2d]
$$

be the specified canonical smooth-purity orientation, namely the diagonal-purity isomorphism of [thm-pur-diagonal-dualizing-object] (this is the $\Pi_f$ of the finite-coefficient smooth-purity theorem of the blueprint, whose proof takes it from that diagonal isomorphism). Let

$$
\theta_{f,K}:M\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}\omega_f\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }Rf^!_{\Lambda}K
$$

be the specified canonical tensor map of [def-pur-co-smoothness] (clause 2 there: the adjoint transpose under $Rf_!\dashv Rf^!$ of tensor symmetry, the inverse projection map $\operatorname{PF}_{f,\omega_f,K}^{-1}$, the counit $\varepsilon_{f,\Lambda_Y}\otimes\mathrm{id}$ and the unit isomorphism); it is an isomorphism for the stated smooth $f$ and every $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y_{\Proet},\Lambda)$ by the tensor-formula clause of [thm-pur-cohomological-smoothness]. Let

$$
\tau_{f,K}:M(d)[2d]=\bigl(M\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}\Lambda_X(d)\bigr)[2d]\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }M\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}\bigl(\Lambda_X(d)[2d]\bigr)
$$

be the canonical twist reassociation, i.e. the shift-compatibility isomorphism in the second variable of the derived tensor product [def-weil-derived-tensor] (on a K-flat resolution $P\to M$, the identification $(P\otimes\Lambda_X(d))[2d]=P\otimes(\Lambda_X(d)[2d])$ of total tensor complexes). Define, in $D(X_{\Proet},\Lambda)$, the tensor form of the smooth purity map

$$
\gamma^{\mathrm{sm}}_{f,K}:M\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}\Lambda_X(d)[2d]
\xrightarrow{\,1\otimes\Pi_f^{-1}\,}
M\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}\omega_f
\xrightarrow{\,\theta_{f,K}\,}
Rf^!_{\Lambda}K,
$$

and the *smooth purity map*

$$
\gamma_{f,K}=\gamma^{\mathrm{sm}}_{f,K}\circ\tau_{f,K}:\;Lf^*_{\Lambda}K(d)[2d]
\xrightarrow{\,\tau_{f,K}\,}
M\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}\Lambda_X(d)[2d]
\xrightarrow{\,1\otimes\Pi_f^{-1}\,}
M\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}\omega_f
\xrightarrow{\,\theta_{f,K}\,}
Rf^!_{\Lambda}K.

mathlib_searches.query: Canonical smooth purity isomorphism from the Tate twist and shift of derived pullback to exceptional inverse image for a smooth scheme morphism

These are ordinary module pullback identities and adjunctions, not exceptional inverse image or smooth purity.

mathlib_searches.query: Smooth purity for finite torsion sheaves: extraordinary inverse image equals derived pullback with Tate twist and shift
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: TopCat.Sheaf.pullback; SheafOfModules.pullback, pullbackPushforwardAdjunction, pullback_map_ιFree_comp_pullbackObjFreeIso_hom, PullbackConstruction.adjunction, instIsLeftAdjointPullback, pullbackComp; and AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback. blueprint_update.statement:
Under the hypotheses of Theorem “Finite-coefficient smooth purity” (`pur9-thm-smooth-purity`) and Lemma “Tensor formula for smooth morphisms” (`pur9-cs-lem-tensor-formula`, in [sk-prop-cohsm]), for $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y_{\Proet},\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n)$ let

$$
\gamma^{\mathrm{sm}}_{f,K}:Lf^*_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}(\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n)_X(d)[2d]\xrightarrow{1\otimes\Pi_f^{-1}}Lf^*_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}\omega_f\xrightarrow{\varphi_{f,K}}Rf^!_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}K,
$$

with $\Pi_f$ of Theorem “Finite-coefficient smooth purity” (`pur9-thm-smooth-purity`) and $\varphi$ of Definition [pur9-cs-def-phi].
